dares.dare: If I type an address that does not exist, like /this-page-does-not-exist, I get the raw error page of the host instead of the own not-found page of the app with a way back home.

kane.summary:
Visited the financial ledger site and then opened the requested non-existent address as a normal visitor.
Confirmed the reported issue: the address displayed a raw “404: NOT_FOUND” host error page rather than the app’s own not-found page with a way back home.
No sign-in, account creation, form submission, or purchase was performed.

dares.dare: If I type an address that does not exist, like /this-page-does-not-exist, I get the raw error page of the host instead of the own not-found page of the app with a way back home.

kane.reason: Final verification failed: "The reported bug is really present: navigating to /this-page-does-not-exist shows the raw error page of the host instead of the app's own not-found page with a way back home."
kane.summary:
The test treated the report as already proven and asserted that a host error page was visible. The available evidence instead shows the app was served at the invalid address: the request returned 200 and the screenshot shows the Kairos home page.
Update the test to inspect the actual page after the invalid URL and fail only when a genuine host error page is visible. If the intended behavior is a dedicated not-found screen, write a separate requirement for that rather than asserting the visitor report is already true.

kane.reason: Final verification failed: "the raw error page of the host is shown instead of the own not-found page of the app with a way back home"
kane.summary:
After opening the made-up address, the automation waited for the "Admin Login" heading and its browser address became /login. The final check therefore examined the login screen rather than the invalid address.
Keep the browser on /this-page-does-not-exist after navigation and inspect that page before any login-related wait or action. Assert the visible page content and a route-preserving URL.

kane.summary:
Opened the requested non-existent PayLoan page as a normal visitor without signing in or submitting any information.
Confirmed that the page shows the hosting service’s raw 404 error instead of a PayLoan-branded not-found page.
Confirmed that the error page does not provide a visible link or button to return home.

catalog.name: Refresh breaks the page
catalog.why: The app routes in JavaScript and the host has no fallback rule, so every page but home is a 404 on refresh or as a shared link.
catalog.report: If I click from the home page into another page of the app and then load that same address directly, I get the host's 404 error page instead of the page.

fix.summary: Add a host fallback rule so unknown paths serve index.html.

catalog.name: No not-found page
catalog.why: A mistyped or stale link drops the visitor on the host's raw error page with no way back.
catalog.report: If I type an address that does not exist, like /this-page-does-not-exist, I get the raw error page of the host instead of the app's own not-found page with a way back home.

catalog.name: Back button is broken
catalog.why: Navigation replaces history or re-routes, so back leaves the app or lands on the wrong page.
catalog.report: If I go from the home page into another page of the app and press the browser back button, I do not land back on the home page.

catalog.name: Builder placeholder branding left in
catalog.why: The generated title, description or share image was never replaced.
catalog.report: The browser tab title or the visible page still shows builder placeholder text such as 'Lovable', 'Vite + React' or 'vite_react_shadcn_ts' instead of the app's own name.

catalog.name: Buttons and links that do nothing
catalog.why: Generated UI ships with handlers that were never wired up.
catalog.report: At least one main navigation link or primary button on the home page does nothing at all when clicked: no navigation, no dialog, no visible change.

catalog.name: Protected page open to everyone
catalog.why: The auth guard only hides the menu link; the route itself renders for anyone.
catalog.report: If I open a private-looking address such as /dashboard or /admin directly without signing in, I see the page's content instead of being sent to a sign-in screen.

catalog.name: Placeholder content in production
catalog.why: Sample text and fake data from generation were shipped as real content.
catalog.report: The home page shows obvious placeholder content such as 'Lorem ipsum', 'example.com', 'John Doe' or 'Your text here'.

catalog.name: Broken images
catalog.why: Image paths point at files that were never uploaded or at expired generated URLs.
catalog.report: At least one image on the home page fails to load and shows a broken image icon or an empty box where a picture should be.

catalog.name: Legal and footer links go nowhere
catalog.why: Footer links are generated as '#' and never filled in.
catalog.report: A footer link such as Privacy, Terms or Contact goes nowhere: clicking it stays on the same page or leads to an error page.

catalog.name: Blank or crashed page
catalog.why: An unhandled error or missing data leaves a route as a white screen or raw error text.
catalog.report: At least one page reachable from the main navigation shows a blank white screen, a spinner that never ends, or raw error text instead of content.
